items.notes: 03 §7.4: one tier, to a club that is itself precarious. Nothing here celebrates.

body: It is two sheets of paper and a pen that belongs to the club.
The division is one above the one you are in. The town is smaller than the one you are in.
The man says welcome and then asks whether you can start on the Monday, because they are short.

choices.outcome_text: You can. There is nothing at home that Monday was for.

choices.text: Ask for a minute and call your mother.
choices.outcome_text: She is on a shift. She says that is wonderful and asks whether they will feed you properly.

body: The terms are better than the last ones and they are not what you imagined terms would be at twenty-three.
There is a clause about appearances that you read twice. It is fair. It is also a number you would have to be first choice to reach.

choices.text: Ask what the clause means in practice.
choices.outcome_text: It means twenty-two starts. Last season the man ahead of you made twenty-six.
The pen is out of ink halfway through your surname and he finds you another one.

body: They want you for what you know, and they say so, and it is the first time anybody has put it that way.
The contract is short. The wage is the highest you have been offered and the length is the shortest.

choices.outcome_text: In the changing room the youngest of them calls you by your surname and a patronymic he has guessed.
He says he would if it were his to give. He does not pretend the answer might change.
